env_keys.comment: API keys and configuration variables documented by the provider.

python_extra.comment: Optional PyPI package: exa-py (install via anysearch-sdk extra `exa`).

requires_key.comment: Valid API key required for every request.

snippet.comment: Short description field returned with each result.

summary.comment: `contents.summary` returns an AI summary per result.

highlights.comment: `contents.highlights` — query-relevant excerpts (~10× fewer tokens than full text).

news.comment: `category: news` or `type` tuned for news-style retrieval.

mode.comment: POST /search `type`: `instant`/`fast` (latency), `auto` (balanced), `deep` / `deep-lite` / `deep-reasoning` (agentic multi-source synthesis; optional `output_schema`). anysearch: fast→fast, balanced→auto, deep→deep.

pricing_per_1k.value: Lite $4; Auto $7; Deep $12 / 1K requests (≤10 results); extra results $1 / 1K each
pricing_per_1k.comment: Units and commitments differ; do not rank these as equivalent flat per-query prices.

primary_price.basis: ≤10 results; Auto/Deep and content add-ons differ

lowest_price.basis: Lite is the cheapest search tier; Auto $7 and Deep $12 / 1K

free_tier_limits.comment: Trial, monthly credits and model-tool promotions are distinct.

p50_latency.value: Historical July 2026: instant: 0.36s p50 / 0.52s p95; fast: 0.67s / 1.34s; auto: ~1.2s; deep: 4.3s avg
p50_latency.comment: Historical evidence retained from July 2026; not remeasured or claimed current. Instant and fast percentiles are independent: three runs of 2,000 queries from the US East Coast. Auto and deep are current provider-reported benchmark figures.

native_api.value: Exa 3.0 released October 19; Lite and Auto; Dynamic Highlights GA. Contents $1 / 1K pages per content type; summaries separately priced.

rate_limits.value: Free 10 QPS; PAYG up to 25 QPS

checked_at.comment: Official public documentation reviewed; no paid API or benchmark run.

capability_basis.comment: SDK availability is separate from native provider capability. Each native feature cell carries its own checked date and evidence.

sdk_support.comment: SDK adapter availability only. See Capability basis for the feature rows; native features do not imply an SDK adapter.
